decisions.briefing: Broad market direction data was unavailable today (NASDAQ/S&P flat), but the screener still surfaced two stocks with full technical confirmation — MACD crossover, bullish RSI, price above SMA-20, and volume surge. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed into FSLY and DOCU as genuine high-conviction setups rather than forcing trades for the sake of using cash.

market_education.summary_en: No reliable market-wide news feed was available today, so index-level direction couldn't be confirmed. Individual stock screens still showed clear technical strength in a handful of names, which is why today's buys were driven by stock-specific signals rather than a market-wide catalyst. This distinction matters: technical confirmation on individual stocks can justify action even when the broader tape is quiet.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤新聞數據暫時無法取得，因此無法確認大盤方向。不過個股篩選中仍有部分股票技術面走強，因此今日的買入決定是基於個股訊號而非大盤催化劑。這點值得留意：即使大盤平靜，個股技術面確認仍可作為進場依據。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum trading means buying stocks that are already showing strong upward price and volume trends, on the theory that the trend will continue in the near term. Today's picks (FSLY, DOCU) were chosen because multiple technical indicators — RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all lined up bullishly at once, which is a stronger signal than any single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能交易是指買入已經展現強勁上升價格與成交量趨勢的股票，理論基礎是趨勢短期內會延續。今日選股（FSLY、DOCU）是因為RSI、MACD、均線與成交量等多項技術指標同時發出看漲訊號，比單一指標更具說服力。
